parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE) as leads_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'hot') as hot_leads, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status = 'pending' AND DATE(due_date) = CURRENT_DATE) as tasks_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'converted' AND DATE(converted_at) = CURRENT_DATE) as converted_today, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE DATE(paid_at) = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'paid') as revenue_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE DATE(sent_at) = CURRENT_DATE AND direction = 'inbound') as messages_received

SELECT t.title, t.priority, tm.name as assigned_to, t.brand FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON t.assigned_to = tm.id WHERE t.status = 'pending' AND DATE(t.due_date) = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY CASE t.priority WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 5

SELECT l.name, l.phone, l.brand, l.score, l.interest FROM leads l WHERE l.status = 'hot' AND (l.last_contacted_at IS NULL OR l.last_contacted_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours') ORDER BY l.score DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT phone_number_id, wa_access_token FROM clients WHERE id = 1 AND phone_number_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
